Closest pattern is the existing username usage in hedged_handler, file_datasource_update_processor and _unfunded_project, which covers the rename but not the llm_factory has_real_project_context guard (current_project is email-named personal project vs username), currently masked by has_project_budget_scopes. Keyword-only signatures mean a missed call site fails with TypeError at runtime; metric label values shift for dashboards; new username-form LiteLLM customers restart budget/spend continuity.

About 12 named production files plus unenumerated set_logging_info/current_user_email callers (about 16 files by codegraph) and about 9+ test modules with roughly 120 occurrences; 0 new files, but 16+ modified files across many directories. Each edit is small and mechanical.
API/auth, service (budget, monitoring), datasource, enterprise LiteLLM external integration, with a cross-cutting logging-context concern changed in several layers. No schema or migration.
